verdict.rationale: Drata's own API documents a multi-framework model: List Frameworks, Create Custom Framework and Framework Requirements, plus control-to-requirement mappings and comparisons. That suggests several frameworks can be run from one platform, and custom frameworks could cover new customer requirements. None of the evidence names HIPAA, GDPR or PCI DSS as supported frameworks, so coverage of the specific frameworks in the story is unproven. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of HIPAA, GDPR and PCI DSS support, evidence of cross-framework control reuse in practice, independent or hands-on corroboration.
